title: Un legado vivo
goal: Read how indigenous languages shaped everyday vocabulary, how the potato reached Europe, and how the Inca economy worked without money.
grammar: Voz pasiva para hablar del legado

items: Explain that hundreds of words were taken directly from Nahuatl or Quechua.
Explain how the potato reached Europe and why it was first viewed with distrust.
State roughly how many indigenous languages are spoken in Latin America today.
Explain how the Inca economy worked without money, through reciprocity and redistribution.
Use passive voice to talk about legacy and language.
